messages:
Maya (CS): FYI ShorelineBank onboarding has gone quiet. Onboarding week 3 but their sandbox calls dropped to zero after we sent the new ingest schema. Renewal in ~72 days; procurement swapped in a new PM (Caroline). Noticed a note: "evaluating ApertureAI POC" in procurement thread.
Ravi (AM): Oof. Are they blocked by infra/schema or are they simply deprioritizing?
Maya (CS): Unknown. They acknowledged the schema email but didn't confirm tests. Sandbox logs show repeated 422s from their side.
Elena (Data): Quick check: ```SELECT day, sum(calls) FROM sandbox_usage WHERE tenant='shoreline' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 10; 2026-03-10|0 2026-03-09|0 2026-03-08|4200``` drop exactly after our schema push on 2026-03-09.
Marco (Solutions): 422 usually means payload validation fail. Can we get a sample failing request from their infra?
Maya (CS): I asked Caroline for the failing POST body; she replied "we'll circle back" but hasn't.
Ravi (AM): Procurement note says ApertureAI trial is limited to embeddings and cheaper per-req. We should prepare a quick cost/latency comparison and a small migration plan.
Elena (Data): I can run a 1-page benchmark showing latency/throughput on standard vector size and include tokenized cost estimate. Need sample vector size (they use 512-d).
Marco (Solutions): Also propose a small compatibility shim that accepts the old payload shape for a 2-week window so their engineers can continue tests while they adjust. Low-risk toggle on our side.
Maya (CS): Good idea. I'll request approval from infra to enable a compatibility flag.
ops-bot: Reminder: Renewal automation created for shorelinebank - renewal date in 72 days.
Ravi (AM): Action items: 1) Maya to get failing payload or logs by EOD. 2) Marco to draft compatibility shim and list of config flags. 3) Elena to run benchmark and cost comparison (48h). 4) I'll schedule a brief sync with Caroline + head of ML.
Maya (CS): On it. I pinged Caroline again and offered a 20-min joint troubleshooting call.
Marco (Solutions): Drafted shim pseudo-config: ```headers: accept-old-schema: true transform: server-side-compat-v1 -> v2``` will post PR if infra OK.
Elena (Data): Benchmark plan: 512-d vectors, 10k batch, measure p50/p95 latency, cost per 1M vectors. Will include ApertureAI public pricing for parity.
Ravi (AM): Offer: 1) 14-day free trial extension for their production sandbox, 2) 4 hours of dedicated onboarding support from Solutions. Caroline mentioned budget is tight.
Maya (CS): Finance approved a one-off sandbox credit up to $3k. I'll confirm in convo.
Marco (Solutions): If they push ApertureAI for price alone, propose a migration checklist + tool-assisted vector export to demonstrate switching cost.
ops-bot: Note: playbook assigned - "onboarding-lull-competitive-poc"; owners: Maya (CS), Marco (tech), Ravi (exec).
Ravi (AM): Can someone drop an internal one-pager for Caroline before the sync? Quick bullets: compatibility shim, credits, onboarding hours, benchmark summary.
Elena (Data): I'll attach preliminary numbers to the one-pager. Link: https://rdw.in/shoreline-bench (draft).
Maya (CS): Caroline accepted a 20-min slot tomorrow 11am ET. I invited Marco and Elena.
Marco (Solutions): I'll bring repro steps and a minimal patch. If we enable shim, need rollback plan; I'll include that in the PR.
Ravi (AM): Great. Goal: get them testing again and remove procurement urgency. Secondary: capture technical blockers in Salesforce.
Maya (CS): I'll log everything in SF and mark risk: medium -> escalate to high only if ApertureAI contract appears.
Elena (Data): After benchmark I'll add a short quality check comparing embeddings similarity on a sample corpus. That should help the ML team decide.
Maya (CS): Thanks team. Will update post-sync. :thumbsup:
